review_scope: Read-only source, AST, frozen-contract and retained-observation review. No test, benchmark, native checker or Lean execution was performed by this reviewer.

state_comparison.reference_precondition: SearchIndex(catalog, root) invokes the unchanged validate_catalog; candidate and newly rebuilt catalogue are canonicalized before the fresh index is used. Its document rows are ordinary finite UTF-8 JSON data without floats; term-frequency rows are new Counters from token strings and integer counts.
typed_properties_preserved: Exact ordinary container and scalar types; booleans remain distinct from integers.
Dictionary membership/content is preserved independently of insertion order, with exact str keys.
List length/order and scalar values remain exact.
The exact Counter type check precedes conversion of explicit contents to dict, retaining extra zero terms and typed counts.
Custom equality cannot grant a match against the fresh ordinary scalar/container types.
Traversal is bounded by the finite fresh expected tree; malformed input cannot expand that expected tree.
state_comparison.nonmatch_behavior: The original canonical serialization comparison, CatalogError conversion and mismatch diagnostics remain byte-for-byte in the fallback branch. Malformed or unequal rows therefore retain the prior diagnostics.
state_comparison.not_a_general_claim: The shortcut relies on the fresh float-free canonical reference. This is not a claim that _same_json equals canonical JSON-byte identity for unrestricted float-bearing values or arbitrary Python objects.

token_identity_skip.eligible_domain: Only type(text) is str and no input character is a Unicode mark or tatweel.
token_identity_skip.removed_work: The original join/removal pass is skipped only when it would preserve every input character.
token_identity_skip.marked_inputs: Any input mark or tatweel sends the original exact string through the unchanged removal generator before the remaining operations.
token_identity_skip.subclasses_and_other_iterables: The type guard short-circuits to the original generator for all non-exact-str values, so the new set/any predicate does not consume their iterators or invoke their conversion/translate methods.
token_identity_skip.result_ownership: The unchanged regular-expression extraction returns a fresh list; no token list is cached.
token_identity_skip.unicode_boundary: Marks introduced by casefold remain after the initial removal phase, exactly as before. The external query _text UTF-8/type/size guard is unchanged.
token_identity_skip.cache_change: No new cache; the existing 4096-entry _is_mark Boolean cache and its bound are unchanged.

preserved_source_and_authority_closure: SearchIndex reconstructs and validates current sources before state comparison.
All document and term-frequency collection membership checks remain.
The accepted result is the new owner index, not the supplied index.
Final source rechecks, source-context joins, request binding, report snapshots and receipt verification functions are unchanged.
No source bytes, catalogue, approval result, receipt or validation verdict are cached by this change.

frozen_acceptance_scope.state_scope: Most adversarial states use an authored small owner fixture and literal outcomes; a separate control reconstructs the installed index and archived retrieval. These are structural controls, not new proof of all source interpretation.
frozen_acceptance_scope.unicode_scope: Existing unchanged anchored deletion coverage plus literal normalization controls. No arbitrary-string or all-iterable completeness is claimed.

existing_reuse_metadata_review: The only observed registry changes add the existing src/nabt/corpus_sources.py owner and the two frozen test paths to the existing rule-routing family. This does not create a new rule engine or semantic authority.
limits: Static reasoning and retained exposed Python acceptance are distinct from a general Lean refinement theorem.
No new runtime speed measurement or CI deadline success is established by this review.
The root-owned existing regression run and all exact-final-head CI gates remain required.
All earlier CI timeouts and local observations remain preserved; no earlier result was relabeled.
